title: Kenkey
description: Kenkey is a Ghana classic prepared with cornmeal, sourdough starter, tilapia, scotch bonnet pepper. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Homemade kenkey-style fermented corn dough; fermentation and wrapping differ from traditional methods. Tilapia is grilled separately.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Cover the batter loosely and leave in a suitable warm, clean place for about 720 minutes to become bubbly and lightly tangy; do not refrigerate during active fermentation.
Divide the fermented corn dough into portions wrapped in heatproof food-safe leaves or parchment and steam until thoroughly set.
Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 15 minutes.
Grill over medium-high heat for about 18 minutes, turning regularly until charred outside and safely cooked inside.
